svg.aria-label: Built so you can experiment safely: local-first, one-click undo, and an honest account of what outlives the folder

g.text: Built so you can experiment safely
Security tools you're afraid to touch are security tools you won't use.
Local-first
Everything it records stays on
your machine, in readable files.
The AI door (Be My Guest) is
only open while you keep it open.
Undo everything
Every block reverses in one click.
The panic button undoes every
block the app ever made.
Nothing is deleted along the way.
Leaving is honest
No installer, no account. Delete the
folder and the app's own files go —
but things it installed into Windows
for you (Sysmon, firewall rules,
hosts pins) outlive the folder.
The way out is built in: the panic button and Settings remove those — Technical Notes lists every location.
AutoCommand · dparksports/autocommand
